name: alibaba/qwen3-32b
description: Qwen3 32B is the largest dense model in Alibaba's open-weight Qwen3 family, released in April 2025 with 32.8 billion parameters. One model switches between a thinking mode for complex logic, math and coding and a non-thinking mode for fast general dialogue. Qwen highlights tool integration in both modes, creative writing, role-play, multi-turn conversation and support for more than 100 languages and dialects. It suits text workloads that want a mid-size open model with optional reasoning.
